outputs.explanation: Panel A is a horizontal bar/timeline chart showing a single measured illumination-overhead percentage per exposure-time condition, not an average across replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel D is a line plot connecting mean±s.e.m. values (n=5) across two time points for each power condition. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel E shows representative micrograph time series (and heatmap-colored images), not an averaged data plot.
Panel F is a scatter plot with individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) shown alongside the fitted mean curve with shaded s.e.m., so individual values are already displayed.
Panel G shows individual data points color-coded by cell overlaid on the fitted curve with shaded s.e.m. band, satisfying the requirement.
Panel H shows individual data points color-coded by cell overlaid on the fitted curve with shaded s.e.m. band, satisfying the requirement.
Panel I is a set of representative dual-color micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel J is a line plot showing the average (of three independent experiments) photobleaching decay curves with shaded s.e.m. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
